article.title: 香港基建補讀：HKT河套AI Exchange開幕，連接本地算力
article.title_en: Hong Kong infrastructure review: HKT opens its Loop AI Exchange
article.summary: HKT於10月28日宣布，河套港深創新及科技園的創科中心及AI Exchange開幕，連接香港主要數據中心集群。
article.summary_en: HKT announced on October 28 that it had opened its Innovation & Technology Centre and AI Exchange at the Loop’s Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park.
article.why: 處理本地客戶資料的企業，可把數據位置及算力連接納入AI供應商評估。
article.why_en: Enterprises handling local customer data can include data location and compute connectivity in AI procurement.
article.next_step: 向供應商查明資料處理位置、實際服務等級及報價，按業務規模評估。
article.next_step_en: Ask providers for processing locations, actual service levels and pricing, then assess business fit.
highlights: 公告規劃以3.2Tbps AI DCI Superhighway連接數據中心，使用空芯光纖。
同一地點亦設有 HKT 與應科院的聯合研發實驗室，旨在推動科研成果商業化。
highlights_en: The announced 3.2Tbps AI DCI Superhighway uses hollow-core fibre to connect data-center clusters.
A joint HKT-ASTRI laboratory at the site aims to commercialize research.
article.detail:
HKT於10月28日宣布，河套港深創新及科技園的創科中心及AI Exchange開幕，連接香港主要數據中心集群。

公告規劃以3.2Tbps AI DCI Superhighway連接數據中心，使用空芯光纖。

同一地點亦設有 HKT 與應科院的聯合研發實驗室，旨在推動科研成果商業化。

處理本地客戶資料的企業，可把數據位置及算力連接納入AI供應商評估。

向供應商查明資料處理位置、實際服務等級及報價，按業務規模評估。

公告不等於跨境資料已獲批准自由流動；沙嶺集群首期預計2027年啟用，現有資料尚不足以確認成本是否較低。
article.detail_en:
HKT announced on October 28 that it had opened its Innovation & Technology Centre and AI Exchange at the Loop’s Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park.

The announced 3.2Tbps AI DCI Superhighway uses hollow-core fibre to connect data-center clusters.

A joint HKT-ASTRI laboratory at the site aims to commercialize research.

Enterprises handling local customer data can include data location and compute connectivity in AI procurement.

Ask providers for processing locations, actual service levels and pricing, then assess business fit.

The opening does not authorize unrestricted cross-border data flow; Sandy Ridge’s first phase is expected in 2027, with no proven cost reduction.
